about: Sample themes for the Excalidraw css prop. Each one is a complete, working stylesheet meant to be read and adapted: pick the closest and change it. <name>.css is the stylesheet. Pass it as css and pass mode as the theme prop beside it. When generated is true, <name>.tokens.json holds the design tokens the stylesheet was generated from with generateThemeCss in @excalidraw/common (schema: tokens.schema.json), so edit the tokens and regenerate instead of the CSS. A theme styles one viewer's editor and sets the defaults for new elements. Existing elements keep their stored colors, and on a shared board everyone sees those stored colors in their own theme.

themes.name: architect-parchment
themes.title: Architect Parchment
themes.description: Flat warm drafting paper with a graph-paper grid, thin graphite ink, pale sage and blue-gray washes and one bronze accent. Calm and technical, for plans and diagrams that should look printed.
themes.pen: Fine graphite nib: pressure-sensitive, slight thinning, long tapered ends.

themes.name: blueprint
themes.title: Blueprint
themes.description: Cyanotype: deep cobalt paper, a white construction grid, chalk-white linework and monospace annotations. For engineering drawings that should read as a blueprint.
themes.pen: Fine chalk line: pressure-sensitive with little thinning and short tapers.
caveats: Dark canvas: pass theme="dark" with it. In light mode, ink drawn in the default black, such as other people's work on a shared board, disappears into this canvas.

themes.name: brutalist
themes.title: Brutalist
themes.description: Raw and loud: hard black borders, offset block shadows, monospace type and acid accents, with no softness anywhere. For bold, opinionated boards.
themes.pen: Thick marker of constant width; pressure is ignored.

themes.name: cad-debug
themes.title: CAD Debug
themes.description: A CAD viewport: blue-gray ground, a white construction grid, graphite edges and a bright debug palette. Solid warm fills mean added material and dashed cool or red outlines mean voids.

themes.name: cel
themes.title: Cel
themes.description: Flat cel illustration on warm grey board: one even slate outline around every shape, rounded forms and muted apricot, sage and slate-blue fills with no shading. Friendly and illustrative.
themes.pen: Medium inking brush: pressure-sensitive with light thinning and blunt ends.

themes.name: e-ink
themes.title: E-ink
themes.description: For e-paper tablets: pure black on white, no gray fills behind text, no shadows and no motion, so the panel never ghosts. The starting point for any low-refresh or print-like display.
themes.pen: Fine stylus pen that swells with pressure and tapers at both ends.

themes.name: gameboy
themes.title: Game Boy
themes.description: Four shades of green and nothing else: the DMG palette, chunky borders and monospace type. A playful retro example of a theme limited to a tiny palette.

themes.name: glass
themes.title: Glass
themes.description: Frosted panels over a pale aurora, made of translucency and a bright edge instead of backdrop-filter, so the canvas never pays for a blur. Shows how to get a soft, modern look cheaply.
themes.pen: Medium pressure pen with moderate thinning and tapered ends.

themes.name: high-contrast
themes.title: High Contrast
themes.description: For low vision: black ground, white text and 2px white edges, yellow for focus and selection, bold strokes and larger text. The reference for an accessibility theme.
themes.pen: Bold constant-width marker; pressure is ignored so every line stays legible.
caveats: Dark canvas: pass theme="dark" with it. In light mode, ink drawn in the default black, such as other people's work on a shared board, disappears into this canvas.
New elements get bold strokes and large text, and collaborators see them at that size.

themes.name: locked-profile
themes.title: Locked Profile
themes.description: The quietest plate: graphite on cool white, no grid, hairline ink and one bronze accent for anything live, with panels that are almost not there. For minimal, distraction-free boards.
themes.pen: Hairline graphite: pressure-sensitive, slight thinning, tapered ends.

themes.name: raking-light
themes.title: Raking Light
themes.description: Low warm key light from the left and cool fill from the right: the paper is one quiet gradient and the panels cast a long shadow away from the light. Medium graphite outlines with sage and bronze bodies.
themes.pen: Graphite pencil: pressure-sensitive, moderate thinning, long tapers.

themes.name: risograph
themes.title: Risograph
themes.description: A two-drum riso print: blue and fluorescent pink on warm stock, with panels printed slightly off register. For posters, zines and playful layouts.
themes.pen: Medium pressure-sensitive pen with strong thinning and short tapers; new shapes are slightly rough.

themes.name: sketchbook
themes.title: Sketchbook
themes.description: A cream sketchbook page with faint ruled lines, soft graphite, colored pencils and hachure, loose and hand-drawn on purpose. For brainstorming and early ideas.
themes.pen: Soft pencil: strong pressure thinning and long tapers; new shapes are drawn rough.

themes.name: swiss
themes.title: Swiss
themes.description: International typographic style: white space, Helvetica, a strict faint grid, black hairlines and one red. For clean, grid-led diagrams.

themes.name: synthwave
themes.title: Synthwave
themes.description: 1986 at midnight: violet night, a magenta and cyan neon grid, glowing panel edges and rounded type. Shows a vivid dark theme whose glow lives in the UI, not the elements.
caveats: Dark canvas: pass theme="dark" with it. In light mode, ink drawn in the default black, such as other people's work on a shared board, disappears into this canvas.

themes.name: terminal
themes.title: Terminal
themes.description: Green phosphor on black: monospace everything, square corners, and a dim glow on UI text with nothing else lit. For console-flavored boards.
caveats: Dark canvas: pass theme="dark" with it. In light mode, ink drawn in the default black, such as other people's work on a shared board, disappears into this canvas.
Element greens display at #6fc76f at most, the brightest green dark mode can show. Only the unfiltered UI text gets full phosphor green.

themes.name: westworld-night
themes.title: Westworld Night
themes.description: A white-on-black stencil: near-black ground, a barely-there grid, crisp bone linework and labels, hollow graphite fills and bronze for anything live. Machined and unhurried.
themes.pen: Fine bone-white nib: pressure-sensitive, light thinning, long tapers.
caveats: Dark canvas: pass theme="dark" with it. In light mode, ink drawn in the default black, such as other people's work on a shared board, disappears into this canvas.

themes.name: win95
themes.title: Windows 95
themes.description: A teal desktop, silver beveled chrome, navy title bars and 1-pixel black ink, like it is 1995. A nostalgic example of restyling the editor's chrome with plain selectors.
themes.pen: MS Paint pencil: constant width with no smoothing, so every wobble stays.
